'''Turese''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].

== Appearance ==
She is young and does not have the ageless look of an Aes Sedai yet.

== Activities ==
She is assigned to look after [[Egwene al'Vere]] and finds her with a recently deceased [[Verin Mathwin]], which she is unaware of. She often shows displeasure when Egwene receives [[Nicola Treehill|Nicola]] and [[Meidani]] as visitors.
